summary: Blender runtime foundation verified on the REAL machine. Detector/validator/probe/launcher/supervisor/receipt/manifest/execute_job compose BlenderEngineAdapter (ProductionEnginePort), registered guarded in the worker composition root. The real runtime probe (scripts/verification/probe_blender_runtime.py) on the baseline machine returns ready=true: Blender 4.5.12 LTS satisfies the pinned 4.5.x LTS policy and the capability probe parsed_ok=true (build 4.5.12 LTS, python 3.11.11, codecs h264/h265/vp9/png/exr/jpeg, gltf/fbx/usd import+export). GPU probe is honest and fail-closed: Cycles enumerated NO CUDA/OptiX device in this headless run -> gpu_ready=false, backend=NONE (CPU-only); the adapter readiness never claims GPU-ready without evidence. Blender 5.1.2 is also present and is correctly REJECTED by the policy (VERSION_MISMATCH) — the version gate rejects 5.x exactly as designed.

candidates: C:/Program Files/Blender Foundation/Blender 5.1/blender.exe -> Blender 5.1.2 (VERSION_MISMATCH, fail closed)
real_machine_probe.policy_result: READY — Blender 4.5.12 satisfies the pinned 4.5.x LTS policy
real_machine_probe.capability_probe: parsed_ok=true, build=4.5.12 LTS, python=3.11.11, codecs=6 (h264/h265/vp9/png/exr/jpeg), importers=6, exporters=6
real_machine_probe.gpu_probe: gpu_ready=false, backend=NONE — Cycles enumerated no CUDA/OptiX/Metal device in this headless run; the probe does NOT claim GPU-ready (fail closed). Renders on this machine are CPU-only until a CUDA/OptiX device is enumerated.

gate_conditions.detail: Blender 4.5.12 LTS installed at C:/Program Files/Blender Foundation/Blender 4.5/blender.exe; validator reason_code=READY.

gate_conditions.detail: contract_tests.json maps every plan matrix item to a real test (57 phase-3 tests).

unlock_conditions_for_gpu: Install/configure an NVIDIA driver exposing CUDA/OptiX to the Blender 4.5 Cycles device enumeration, then re-probe; gpu_ready=true is required before any GPU-accelerated render is claimed.
